Select approved drugs with mechanism of action action_type 'ANTAGONIST' and max_phase = 4. Join molecule_dictionary with drug_mechanism on molregno. Join target_dictionary on drug_mechanism.tid. Join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id as target_chembl_id, and target_name as target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
